reply: Thank you for explaining that you are repaying a loan with a 160% APR and can no longer afford the payments after being laid off. We are sorry for the difficulty this has caused. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for your payment history and what hardship options are available, and keep a copy of your loan agreement. A nonprofit credit counselor may also help. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid $77.00 through a pay-later plan for services that were never provided, and that you are still being charged while the merchant cannot be reached. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please send a written dispute stating that the services were not provided, and keep any receipts and messages with the merchant. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two payments were taken from your account when only one was due, and that you have already sent screenshots and your bank's confirmation. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the screenshots and your bank's confirmation, and ask your bank whether it can provide a dated transaction history for both debits. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are still paying a solar loan for a system that has not produced energy for months, and that the installer and its subcontractor are out of business. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep the monitoring reports, utility bills and loan agreement, and ask in writing what options are available for systems that are not working. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that, as a servicemember, you asked for the interest rate limit on debt taken out before your service and have not received clear guidance. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the servicemember benefits team. Please send a written request with a copy of your military orders, and ask how any interest charged above the limit will be handled. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told your on-time loan payments would be reported to all three major credit reporting companies, but they do not appear on your reports. We understand why this matters to you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep any messages or disclosures about reporting, and ask in writing which companies your accounts are reported to. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after your vehicle was totaled, you learned the GAP coverage you signed for had been cancelled without notice, and that the lender still holds the title. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep your signed loan agreement and payment records, and ask in writing when and why the GAP coverage was cancelled. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $300.00 purchase you financed was marked as delivered but never reached you, and that the merchant will not replace it or refund it. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please send a written dispute with the delivery photo and the merchant's messages, and keep your order records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your solar loan included finance charges and lien terms you say were not clearly explained, and that your payments are much higher than expected. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for a copy of your loan agreement and disclosures showing the finance charge and total cost, and keep your sales materials. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked a collection company to validate a debt and received a reply threatening a judgment and lien instead, along with repeated calls. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep the validation request, the reply and a log of the calls. If you receive court papers, respond by the deadline so you keep your options. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $500.00 graphics card you financed was never delivered, and that your dispute was closed without you seeing the merchant's evidence. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please ask in writing for a copy of the evidence used to close your dispute, and keep your screenshots, payment proof and reports. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you closed your account to cancel a subscription, but the fee was still debited a month later and support stopped responding. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep proof of your cancellation and account closure, and tell your bank in writing that you did not authorize the debit. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that $230.00 was taken from a new cash advance to cover an earlier advance you had already repaid, after a third-party review. We understand your confusion. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please ask in writing for a full history of your advances and repayments, and keep your bank statements showing the earlier repayment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid all four installments for a $58.00 order but never received the shirts, and that the merchant did not respond to your cancellation request. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please send a written dispute with your payment emails and your messages to the merchant, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you made a timely online payment on your pawn loan, received a receipt, and the item was still pulled. We understand your frustration, especially with the blocked payments. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep the payment receipt and records of the blocked attempts, and ask in writing for the status of the item and your payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you took out a payday loan during a very difficult time and that the repayments now leave you very little to live on. We are sorry you are facing this. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for your loan terms and payment history, and whether an extended payment plan is available. A nonprofit credit counselor may also help. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told your consolidation loan would pay off your car loan, but the car loan was not paid. We understand your frustration, since this was the reason you accepted the loan. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for the list of accounts paid by the loan, and keep your loan documents and payment records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your spending limit of $2,500.00 was reduced shortly after a $1,000.00 loan was funded, and that the explanation seemed inconsistent. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for the terms that explain how your limit is set and when it can change, and keep the messages you received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your payoff was processed twice, the refund was sent incorrectly, and then $25,000.00 was debited from your checking account without the call you were told to expect. We understand how serious this is. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the payments team. Please keep your bank statements and chat records, and ask in writing for a full payoff reconciliation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you made every payment on your $12,000.00 loan, paid the balance in full, and then received a notice saying you owe $6,100.00 more. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for an itemized statement and a full payment history, and keep proof of your final payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you did not receive the loan disclosures at origination and that the loan documents show electronic signatures you say are not yours. We understand how serious this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for copies of all signed documents and the record of how each signature was captured, and keep copies of what you have. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were rushed through a title loan contract, that your car was repossessed, and that you paid fees to recover it before signing a new contract. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for copies of both contracts and an itemized list of fees, and keep your receipts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a representative came to your home to demand payment in person and said the company would file suit if you did not pay. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please write down the date, time and what was said, and send a written request about how you want to be contacted. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have paid almost $1,200.00 on a $1,000.00 installment loan and are told you still owe over $2,000.00. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for your loan agreement, the interest terms and a payment history. Your state's financial regulator can explain the rules for these loans where you live. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that payments for a personal loan continued after you tried to revoke authorization, including one larger than your scheduled payment. We understand your frustration, especially since the program you paid for collapsed. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep your revocation request, and tell your bank in writing that the authorization was revoked. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have asked several times for confirmation and payoff letters for your two installment loans, and have been given conflicting answers. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please send a written request for payoff letters and a complete payment history for each loan, and keep proof of your payments. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked to withdraw your small business loan application, and that the lender continued to act on it afterward. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep the email where you withdrew the application and the reply you received, and ask in writing for confirmation that the application is closed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you missed a payment grace period while waiting for support to reply, and were then charged several late and failed payment fees. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the dates of your support requests, and ask in writing for a review of the fees. Pay-later plans can charge fees, so check your agreement. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged about $1,800.00 in deferred interest even though you believe you paid the balance within the promotional period. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep proof of each payment date, and send a written request for the account ledger and the promotional terms. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you want to accept a settlement offer on your loan, but the proposed payment dates do not fit your financial situation. We understand you want to resolve the account responsibly. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send your proposed payment dates in writing, and ask for any agreement to be confirmed in writing before you pay. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
